description: Enterprise-Grade Hospital Management System (HMS) built with MERN Stack

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('client')) execSync('cd client && npm install', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
